mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% for two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS declines in isolation, or when the joint correlation with S&P 500 returns drops below -0.2 in a 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing risk-free rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend, measured as a 3-month moving average increase, indicates improving manufacturing conditions, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO's 3-month moving average is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units in a single month signals housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000.
